steps: js:window.__set = (label, v) => { const el = document.querySelector(`[aria-label="${label}"]`); el.focus(); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent('focusout', { bubbles: true })); el.blur(); return true }; true

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const items=(await window.__api('GET','/contract-items')).body;const it=items.find((x)=>x.code===sessionStorage.getItem('ciCode'));sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body.find((x)=>x.name==='월말청구');const p=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body[0];const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const r=await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-정기계약',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:'01,02,03,04,05,06,07,08,09,10,11,12',quantity:2,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:null}]});sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',r.body.id);return r.status+' '+r.body.totalAmount})()
